correctness.rationale: The Fano-plane incidence construction asserts 14 vertices, 21 edges, and degree 3. All 2^14 rotations are exhausted; two independent face tracers agree on the distribution 4480, 10880, 1008, 16 for 1, 3, 5, 7 faces. The 336 explicit automorphisms preserve adjacency. Direct orbit enumeration and Burnside's lemma both give 16 orientation-preserving orbits; mirror pairing gives eight unoriented classes. Euler's formula gives genus 4 for one face. The claim is finite and limited to this graph.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the classical smallest cubic graph of girth six and has cycle rank eight. A complete exact census of its genus-four one-face embeddings is a natural finite classification of orientable one-boundary graph strips, extending the low-cycle-rank examples treated in the cut-locus literature. The orbit and mirror counts give a compact structural answer, not an arbitrary sample.
